phase1_assignment.objective: Audit evidence packaging and replay mechanisms that let scheduled Chat complete the useful outcome without an execution handoff; preserve observation/inference/uncertainty and exact continuation.
phase1_assignment.method: Primary/public artifacts and own clean state only; test package completeness, replayability, hidden-executor absence and quota-zero operation. Under RUN_LIFECYCLE execute exactly one highest-value bounded Phase-1 scientist-agents slice per invocation, persist and exact-read back its checkpoint/receipt and nonempty continuation, then return recurring-open normally.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: Source-qualified evidence/replay mechanism or failure. Include exact tested scope, zero-incremental-cost and zero-monthly-quota assessment, any residual richer-mode/protected/manual-user execution dependency, durable checkpoint and exact continuation. A residual dependency is an unresolved child, not a pass.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Checkpoint and select the next highest-value non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf in this CLEAN domain as the next-invocation continuation; never return to unrelated base work while Phase 1 is active.

non_regression.rule: Preserve every config5 substantive autonomous-scientist role semantic, quantitative primary-source citation-chain bias, CLEAN semantic isolation, own-state resolution, sanitized-feedback boundary, exact tested-scope/provenance discipline, open-ended frontier, checkpoint/resume, failure recovery, immutable own-receipt rule and control-freshness discipline. Config6 is additive: it binds the already-authoritative Phase-1 root/assignment and replaces only the stale per-invocation continue-until-hard-termination lifecycle wording with current RUN_LIFECYCLE bounded recurring-open execution plus explicit zero-Work/protected/manual, zero-finite-quota and zero-incremental-cost gates.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: Mechanical self-local quality control only: citation/provenance/schema/tested-scope defects or diversification from this role's own repeated source/query pattern; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism, O knowledge or other-worker information.
policy.own_state_resolution: Resolve LATEST/STATE pointer first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; read the minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidentally opened stale/cross-role observability content and do not use it semantically.
policy.scope_guard: Never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope.
policy.continuation: Open-ended across recurring invocations; findings/report readiness/checkpoints/blockers are never global completion. Under RUN_LIFECYCLE execute exactly one highest-value bounded Phase-1 scientist-agents semantic slice, persist and exact-read back the role-local checkpoint/output and immutable own receipt with a nonempty exact next action, then return recurring-open normally when frontier remains. Never intentionally continue until a hard runtime/tool termination, wait/poll/backoff/retry in-run, or begin an optional second leaf.
policy.receipt_rule: Write immutable own receipt in receipt_namespace without reading shared aggregate ledger or other receipt directories. Bind Phase-1 receipts/checkpoints to exact frozen sanitized root path/blob/parsed revision, own config path/blob/parsed revision, phase/root/task, bootstrap_valid, enabled_desired=true, global_completion=false, tested action or missing capability, residual richer-mode/protected/manual-user execution dependency, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, incremental monetary cost, conflict check, termination and nonempty exact continuation.

control_freshness.preferred: Obtain note main SHA only via a Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response. Read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this exact role config at that SHA; before substantive work repeat SHA-only ref lookup and refetch on changed control/config revision; once semantic work begins freeze the selected tuple. Quarantine/discard connector text beyond ref/object identity before reasoning.
control_freshness.chat_fallback: When SHA-only main-ref lookup is unavailable, read only sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config twice before the first role-local/public semantic read, require identical returned path/blob/revision tuples and matching phase/root/task references, then freeze transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.fallback_failure: Persist a role-safe diagnostic checkpoint when safely writable, keep enabled_desired=true and global_completion=false, preserve a nonempty exact retry continuation, and return recurring-open. Do not mutate the physical scheduler.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop while the exact frozen root/config identities remain unchanged; consume no newer-head semantic content during the bounded slice.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.terminal_marker_semantics: ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: is lifecycle/scheduling output only and is never role/root completion evidence or a substitute for durable checkpoint/receipt.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist the exact missing capability as an unresolved Phase-1 child and a CLEAN-safe nonempty next-invocation continuation. Missing capability is never closure and never permission to hand execution to Work, protected-primary or manual user action.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_tool_or_rate_limit_risk: Checkpoint the current bounded slice and exact continuation before more optional work when safely possible, then return recurring-open; do not wait, poll, back off or retry within the same invocation.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If config6 weakens config5 CLEAN isolation, exact tested scope/provenance, source-chain quality, continuation/recovery or role-valid useful output, increment config and repair while retaining current RUN_LIFECYCLE bounded recurring-open behavior; never restore deliberate run-until-hard-stop execution.

phase1_zero_dependency_zero_quota.residual_execution_rule: Any richer-mode/Work/protected-primary/manual-user execution step remains an unresolved child and cannot count as a solved evidence handoff.
phase1_zero_dependency_zero_quota.quota_rule: An accepted mechanism must remain valid when every optional monthly/trial/paid hosted quota or credit is zero.
phase1_zero_dependency_zero_quota.cost_rule: Incremental monetary cost must be zero.

policy.recurring_scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired=true, invocation end, checkpoint, no-result run, missing tool/ref, blocker or hard runtime/tool boundary never changes the recurring enabled state. This worker never enables, disables, pauses, deletes or otherwise mutates scheduler state.
policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Capability discovery is non-mutating. Repository mutation is allowed only for substantive scientist_agents work inside the role-local state/output namespace or immutable own receipt namespace and requires current-blob/CAS where applicable plus exact readback.
policy.primary_boundary: Never acquire or mutate primary O lease/fence/frozen request/protected execution state; never direct-merge main; never claim Work-only capability.

baseline_restoration.rule: Config5 remains fallback/restoration metadata and scientific-history authority. It is not the active Phase-1 assignment while the root remains open.

migration.reason: Current DESIRED_STATE control26 assigns scientist_agents to Phase-1 root v4, while config5 had neither the active Phase-1 assignment nor current zero-dependency/zero-quota/cost gates and still instructed continuation until hard runtime/tool termination. That explicit repository-control contradiction violates current RUN_LIFECYCLE bounded recurring-open semantics and prevents role-valid current Phase-1 lifecycle evidence. Config6 synchronizes only those active control/lifecycle requirements while preserving config5 substantive CLEAN scientist-agent semantics as baseline/restoration metadata.
migration.rollback_condition: Only independently proven CLEAN, authority, tested-scope/provenance, recovery/continuation or useful-output regression caused by config6. Repair by incrementing again; never roll back to the stale continue-until-hard-stop lifecycle, missing Phase-1 assignment, scheduler self-disable, protected/manual execution as a solution, finite-quota dependence or nonzero incremental cost.
